name: ModelVariant137_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant137_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (64 sparks gather on a slot part, a ring swells, an orb flies to the other slot, 16 drops rain after it and the screen flashes); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the spark and drop points, packs three texture images and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 4 while the drops start, 1 once after they have all started, 2 once they end and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-154 and 284 images build it without the work-size printf and with a 256-line flash, so their data names bind 0x1C lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
